name: planning
description: Structured implementation planning, interactive annotation review via Plannotator (with a local fallback), and plan execution with an adaptive review cascade sized to the plan.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a design into a task-by-task plan, review it, then execute it
interface.longDescription: Structured implementation planning (make) and autonomous plan execution (exec) for non-trivial, multi-file changes. Plan review defers to Plannotator when installed, falling back to a bundled annotation script otherwise. The review cascade during execution scales to plan size, and external adversarial review is always opt-in, never automatic. Supports project and user level custom rules, and ships a PreToolUse hook that prevents the skill from modifying its own files.
defaultPrompt: Use planning to write an implementation plan for this feature.
Review this implementation plan before I start building it.
